Message:
feat(api): snooze for commitments + momentum signals (WP5, D2) (#108)

Persisted hidden-until state via nullable snoozedUntil on commitments
+ momentum_signals (migration 0037). Status enums untouched: snoozed
items stay open/active, are filtered from attention surfaces, and
auto-resurface when the timestamp passes (pure query filtering, no
cron). PATCH /:id/snooze on both routes mirrors the atomic
conditional-update dismiss pattern (409 on non-eligible status).
getActiveSignals() is the single choke point (dashboard + Telegram);
snoozed signals still expire while hidden.
